title: Psalm 96
opening_line: O sing a new song to the LORD:

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: O sing a new song to the LORD:
text.normalized: O sing a new song to the LORD:
text.reading: O sing a new song to the LORD:

text.diplomatic: sing all the earth to GOD.
text.normalized: Sing all the earth to GOD.
text.reading: sing all the earth to GOD.

text.diplomatic: To GOD sing, bless his name, show still
text.normalized: To GOD sing, bless his name, show still
text.reading: To GOD sing, bless his name, show still

text.diplomatic: his saving health abroad.
text.normalized: His saving health abroad.
text.reading: his saving health abroad.

text.diplomatic: Among the heathen nätions
text.normalized: Among the heathen nätions
text.reading: Among the heathen nätions

text.diplomatic: his glory do declare;
text.normalized: His glory do declare;
text.reading: his glory do declare;

text.diplomatic: And unto all the people show
text.normalized: And unto all the people show
text.reading: And unto all the people show

text.diplomatic: his works that wondrous are.
text.normalized: His works that wondrous are.
text.reading: his works that wondrous are.

text.diplomatic: For great’s the LORD, and greatly he
text.normalized: For great’s the LORD, and greatly he
text.reading: For great’s the LORD, and greatly he

text.diplomatic: is to be magnified;
text.normalized: Is to be magnified;
text.reading: is to be magnified;

text.diplomatic: Yea, worthy to be feared is he
text.normalized: Yea, worthy to be feared is he
text.reading: Yea, worthy to be feared is he

text.diplomatic: above all gods beside.
text.normalized: Above all gods beside.
text.reading: above all gods beside.

text.diplomatic: For all the gods are idols dumb,
text.normalized: For all the gods are idols dumb,
text.reading: For all the gods are idols dumb,

text.diplomatic: which blinded nations fear;
text.normalized: Which blinded nations fear;
text.reading: which blinded nations fear;

text.diplomatic: But our God is the LORD, by whom
text.normalized: But our God is the LORD, by whom
text.reading: But our God is the LORD, by whom

text.diplomatic: the heav’ns created were.
text.normalized: The heav’ns created were.
text.reading: the heav’ns created were.

text.diplomatic: Great honour is before his face,
text.normalized: Great honour is before his face,
text.reading: Great honour is before his face,

text.diplomatic: and majesty divine;
text.normalized: And majesty divine;
text.reading: and majesty divine;

text.diplomatic: Strength is within his holy place,
text.normalized: Strength is within his holy place,
text.reading: Strength is within his holy place,

text.diplomatic: and there doth beauty shine.
text.normalized: And there doth beauty shine.
text.reading: and there doth beauty shine.

text.diplomatic: Do ye ascribe unto the LORD,
text.normalized: Do ye ascribe unto the LORD,
text.reading: Do ye ascribe unto the LORD,

text.diplomatic: of people ev’ry tribe,
text.normalized: Of people ev’ry tribe,
text.reading: of people ev’ry tribe,

text.diplomatic: Glory do ye unto the LORD,
text.normalized: Glory do ye unto the LORD,
text.reading: Glory do ye unto the LORD,

text.diplomatic: and mighty pow’r ascribe.
text.normalized: And mighty pow’r ascribe.
text.reading: and mighty pow’r ascribe.

text.diplomatic: Give ye the glory to the LORD
text.normalized: Give ye the glory to the LORD
text.reading: Give ye the glory to the LORD

text.diplomatic: that to his name is due;
text.normalized: That to his name is due;
text.reading: that to his name is due;

text.diplomatic: Come ye into his courts, and bring
text.normalized: Come ye into his courts, and bring
text.reading: Come ye into his courts, and bring

text.diplomatic: an offering with you.
text.normalized: An offering with you.
text.reading: an offering with you.

text.diplomatic: In beauty of his holiness,
text.normalized: In beauty of his holiness,
text.reading: In beauty of his holiness,

text.diplomatic: O do the LORD adore;
text.normalized: O do the LORD adore;
text.reading: O do the LORD adore;

text.diplomatic: Likewise let all the earth throughout
text.normalized: Likewise let all the earth throughout
text.reading: Likewise let all the earth throughout

text.diplomatic: tremble his face before.
text.normalized: Tremble his face before.
text.reading: tremble his face before.

text.diplomatic: Among the heathen say, GOD reigns;
text.normalized: Among the heathen say, GOD reigns;
text.reading: Among the heathen say, GOD reigns;

text.diplomatic: the world shall stedfastly
text.normalized: The world shall stedfastly
text.reading: the world shall stedfastly

text.diplomatic: Be fixed from moving; he shall judge
text.normalized: Be fixed from moving; he shall judge
text.reading: Be fixed from moving; he shall judge

text.diplomatic: the people righteously.
text.normalized: The people righteously.
text.reading: the people righteously.

text.diplomatic: Let heav’ns be glad before the Lord,
text.normalized: Let heav’ns be glad before the Lord,
text.reading: Let heav’ns be glad before the Lord,

text.diplomatic: and let the earth rejoice;
text.normalized: And let the earth rejoice;
text.reading: and let the earth rejoice;

text.diplomatic: Let seas, and all that is therein,
text.normalized: Let seas, and all that is therein,
text.reading: Let seas, and all that is therein,

text.diplomatic: cry out, and make a noise.
text.normalized: Cry out, and make a noise.
text.reading: cry out, and make a noise.

text.diplomatic: Let fields rejoice, and everything
text.normalized: Let fields rejoice, and everything
text.reading: Let fields rejoice, and everything

text.diplomatic: that springeth of the earth:
text.normalized: That springeth of the earth:
text.reading: that springeth of the earth:

text.diplomatic: Then woods and ev’ry tree shall sing
text.normalized: Then woods and ev’ry tree shall sing
text.reading: Then woods and ev’ry tree shall sing

text.diplomatic: with gladness and with mirth
text.normalized: With gladness and with mirth
text.reading: with gladness and with mirth

text.diplomatic: Before the LORD; because he comes,
text.normalized: Before the LORD; because he comes,
text.reading: Before the LORD; because he comes,

text.diplomatic: to judge the earth comes he:
text.normalized: To judge the earth comes he:
text.reading: to judge the earth comes he:

text.diplomatic: He’ll judge the world with righteousness,
text.normalized: He’ll judge the world with righteousness,
text.reading: He’ll judge the world with righteousness,

text.diplomatic: the people faithfully.
text.normalized: The people faithfully.
text.reading: the people faithfully.
